title: A global well-posedness result for the three-dimensional inviscid quasi-geostrophic equation over a cylindrical domain
summary: The three-dimensional quasi-geostrophic equation is considered over a cylindrical domain with a multiply connected horizontal cross-section. Homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions, tantamount to homogeneous density fields, are imposed on the top and bottom surfaces, while no-flux boundary conditions combined with constant circulations are imposed on the lateral boundary loops. The global existence and uniqueness of a generalized solution is proven, provided that the initial potential vorticity (PV) field is essentially bounded.
